title: YouTube star Hank Green sets new AI policy for himself — and urges other content creators to do the same
excerpt: Hank Green, a YouTube star, announced a new personal AI policy after apologizing for relying too heavily on the tech.
content_html:
Hank Green, the popular content creator and YouTube star, announced a new AI policy for himself on Friday — and encouraged others to do the same.

In a video posted to the Vlogbrothers YouTube channel that he shares with his brother, author and creator John Green, Green addressed the apology he made last week about "relying too heavily on AI" for research.

"This all started because I said I needed to realign the way I use LLMs. I have thought a lot about that this week. I'd become too reliant on them for advice, for editing, and for sourcing," Green said in the video. "So I'm creating an AI policy for myself."

He outlined "The Hank Green AI Policy" as follows:

  1. No portion of any script will be written, edited, or outlined by an LLM.
  2. The thesis of a video will always originate with a human.
  3. No image or music in a video will be generated by AI. If something is accidentally included, best efforts will be made to remove it.

Green also encouraged other content creators to make an AI policy for themselves.

"It doesn't even have to be public. Just have it. I wish I had had it," he said.

After criticism from some fans over his use of AI, Green apologized to his audience in a Reddit comment last week and said he would slow down or pause some of his projects. He said he'd pause the daily word games he produces, SMUSH and 4x3, and would post less on his Hankschannel YouTube page.

In his latest video, Green said he'd been "so enticed by LLMs" that he was using them to start and research many different projects, all at the same time."

"The more time I spent with it, the more every problem was starting to look like an LLM-shaped problem," he said. "And that's dumb."

Green also apologized to the employees at Complexly, a nonprofit founded by the Green brothers, who help produce some of their most popular YouTube shows, like SciShow and CrashCourse. He said Complexly already had an AI policy and defended the work it had produced.

"Whatever reputational hit or loss of trust I have brought upon myself here, that's mine to take and try to earn back," he said.

Green said he plans to slow down his content production and be more "choosy" about the opportunities he pursues.

"Making more things does not make me make better things," he said. "And people need to be able to absolutely trust that my takes are my takes — which they are."

Green and Complexly did not immediately respond to requests for comment from Business Insider.

content_html_zh:
受欢迎的内容创作者和 YouTube 明星汉克·格林 (Hank Green) 周五为自己宣布了一项新的人工智能政策，并鼓励其他人也这样做。

在他与兄弟、作家兼创作者约翰·格林分享的 Vlogbrothers YouTube 频道上发布的视频中，格林表达了他上周就“过于依赖人工智能”进行研究而做出的道歉。

“这一切都是因为我说我需要重新调整我使用法学硕士的方式而开始。 这周我想了很多。 我变得过于依赖他们的建议、编辑和采购，”格林在视频中说道。 “所以我正在为自己制定人工智能政策。”

他概述了“汉克绿色人工智能政策”如下：

  1. 任何剧本的任何部分都不会由法学硕士编写、编辑或概述。
  2. 视频的主题总是源自人类。
  3. 视频中的图像或音乐不会由人工智能生成。 如果意外包含某些内容，我们将尽最大努力将其删除。

格林还鼓励其他内容创作者为自己制定人工智能政策。

“它甚至不必公开。 就拥有它吧。 我希望我拥有它，”他说。

在一些粉丝批评他对人工智能的使用后，格林上周在 Reddit 评论中向观众道歉，并表示他将放慢或暂停他的一些项目。 他表示，他将暂停每天制作的文字游戏《SMUSH》和《4x3》，并减少在他的 Hankschannel YouTube 页面上发布的内容。

格林在他最新的视频中表示，他“被法学硕士如此吸引”，以至于他利用它们来同时启动和研究许多不同的项目。”

“我花在这上面的时间越多，每个问题就越开始看起来像法学硕士问题，”他说。 “那太愚蠢了。”

格林还向 Complexly 的员工道歉，Complexly 是格林兄弟创立的非营利组织，帮助制作了一些最受欢迎的 YouTube 节目，例如 SciShow 和 CrashCourse。 他表示 Complexly 已经制定了人工智能政策，并为其所做的工作辩护。

他说：“无论我在这里给自己带来了什么样的声誉打击或失去信任，我都会承担并努力挽回。”

格林表示，他计划放慢内容制作速度，并对自己追求的机会更加“挑剔”。

“制造更多的东西并不会让我制造出更好的东西，”他说。 “人们需要能够绝对相信我的看法就是我的看法——事实确实如此。”

Green and Complexly 没有立即回应《商业内幕》的置评请求。
